name: oai-agent
description: Coding agent for VS Code that works with the STARK API gateway and other OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

oaiAgent.apiMode.description: Which OpenAI-compatible API to use. Use 'responses' if your gateway only passes tool definitions through /responses.

oaiAgent.model.description: Model name sent to the endpoint. Must support tool/function calling.

oaiAgent.models.description: Models to show in the model picker (in addition to those the server lists).

oaiAgent.contextWindow.description: Upper bound for the conversation in tokens (the model's limit). Day to day, compactAt/compactTo keep the conversation much smaller than this. If the gateway reports a tokens-per-minute limit below it, the agent stays under that limit; if a model's real limit is smaller, it adapts.

oaiAgent.compactAt.description: Summarize the oldest steps when the conversation passes this many tokens. Lower = fewer tokens per step but the agent re-reads files more often. Never exceeds 70% of the context window.

oaiAgent.compactTo.description: After summarizing, keep about this many tokens (system prompt, summary and the most recent steps).

oaiAgent.maxSteps.description: Max model calls per user message.

enumDescriptions: Ask before file edits, commands and web fetches
Auto-approve file edits; ask for commands and web fetches

oaiAgent.autoApproveCommands.description: Command prefixes that run without asking.

oaiAgent.autoApproveReadOnlyCommands.description: Run commands that only read (Get-Content, Get-ChildItem, Select-String, type, dir, findstr, cat, grep, git status/diff/log, node --check, tsc --noEmit, --version checks) without asking, when every path they touch is inside the workspace. Commands with pipes, variables, chaining or redirects always ask.

oaiAgent.autoApproveReadOnlyScripts.description: Also run read-only PowerShell scripts (pipelines, variables, ForEach-Object, [regex] calls) without asking. PowerShell's own parser analyzes the script without running it; it runs only if every command, .NET call and path is read-only and inside the workspace. Needs PowerShell (built into Windows).

oaiAgent.shell.description: Shell for run_command. Empty (default): PowerShell on Windows (PowerShell 7 if installed, otherwise the built-in Windows PowerShell), and the system shell on macOS and Linux. Set to cmd.exe, pwsh, or a shell path to override.

oaiAgent.extraHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with each request.

oaiAgent.extraBody.description: Extra JSON fields merged into each request body.
